The Exchange had sought clarification from General Insurance Corporation of India with respect to Non-compliance as per Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.  On basis of above the Company was required to clarify the following:     -1. The company has not submitted the Statement of Modified Opinion or in case of unmodified opinion(s), a declaration to that effect to the Stock Exchange.  The response of the Company is enclosed.

GICRE:The Exchange had sought clarification from General Insurance Corporation of India with respect to announcement dated 25-May-2018, regarding the Board of Directors at its meeting held on May 25, 2018, have considered and approved bonus at the ratio of 1 : 1, i.e 1 Equity Shares for every 1 Equity Shares held. On basis of above the Company is required to clarify following: 1. Estimated date by which such bonus shares would be credited/dispatched.2. Whether thefigures are audited;3. Free reserves and/ or share premium available for capitalization and the date as on which such balance is available;4. Free reserves and/ or share premium required for implementing the bonus issue;5. Details of share capital - pre and post bonus issue;6. Bonus ratio;7. Whether bonus is out of free reserves created out of profits or share premium account;The response of the Company is ataached.

GICRE:The Exchange has sought clarification from General Insurance Corporation of India with respect to announcement dated 25-May-2018, regarding " General Insurance Corporation of India has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors at its meeting held on May 25, 2018, have considered and approved bonus at the ratio of 1 : 1, i.e 1 Equity Shares for every 1 Equity Shares held.". General Insurance Corporation of India has informed the Exchange that the Company has fixed Record Date as July 14, 2018 for the purpose of 1. For the purpose of taking record of eligible/Beneficial Owners for payment of Equity Dividend as may be approved by the Members in the ensuing  Annual General Meeting of the Corporation .2. For determining the eligibility of shareholders/Beneficial Owners who are entitled for receipt of Bonus shares subject to the approval of shareholders which would be taken through the process of Postal Ballot and remote E-voting.
